verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms core repo management: cloning via GitHub CLI (`gh repo clone`), SSH-based git authentication for push/pull, and downloading/cloning/forking repositories are all documented first-party GitHub capabilities. However, no citation explicitly addresses browsing commit history UI/API features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of commit history browsing (e.g., commit log view, blame, diff comparison) and independent hands-on corroboration of repo creation/management workflow.
